8439: Soul's partner and the female protagonist of the series. Known to be cheerful, direct, confident, smart and hardworking, in stark contrast to Soul who is much more laid-back in comparison.
8443: A demon weapon partnered with Black Star hailing from the Nakatsukasa Clan, a special weapons clan who are direct descendants of demon weapons created by the mother of magic weapons, Arachne Gorgon.
8444: A Demon Weapon and the younger sister of Elizabeth Thompson. Known as one of the "Demon Twin Guns", both her and her sister were known as the "Brooklyn Devils" and were petty thugs until being found by their current Meister, Death the Kid.
8445: A demon weapon and the older sister of Patricia Thompson. Formerly a thuggish ruffian alongside her sister raised in the streets of New York, both her own and sister's life turn for the better when they encountered their future meister, Death the Kid.
8446: The eccentric yet incredibly talented doctor and meister who is hailed as the DWMA's strongest graduate in history. He later joins the academy as an instructor.
8455: The son of Death himself and the Meister of the Demon Twin Guns, Liz Thompson and Patty Thompson. Created from a piece of Death's soul, Death the Kid is known to be one of the top 3 students in the DWMA, albeit with a confounding obsession when it comes to symmetry.
8456: Maka's partner and the male protagonist of the series. Soul is a demon weapon who was born into a family of famous musicians. After discovering his weapon abilities as a Demon Weapon Soul joined the DWMA, where he partnered up with Maka.
8457: The grim reaper himself. He is by far the most powerful character in the series. He is a bit of a joker but when the time comes, he's all business. His number is 42-42-564 (shini-shini-koroshi), which literally means die-die-kill in Japanese.
8458: A playful cat with powerful magic that Soul and Maka initially confused for a regular witch.
8462: He is the Shinigami’s current weapon and Maka’s father. He is very protective of Maka and is ready to jump to her aid any time she’s in trouble (he is always stopped by the Shinigami).
8464: A shadow weapon meister and the last survivor of the infamous Star Clan, taken into the DWMA and raised by Sid Barrett. His weapon partner is Tsubaki Nakatsukasa.
11919: The demon sword Ragnarok's meister and the biological child of the witch Medusa Gorgon. They're driven by their mother's aim to turn them into a Kishin.
11921: Ragnarok, also known as the Demon Sword, is the weapon partner of Crona. Born a normal demon weapon, it was melted by Medusa in a vat of Black Blood while in its weapon form and mixed into Crona's blood.
11924: One of the major antagonists of the series, Medusa is a powerful witch and the middle sibling among the three Gorgon Sisters. She is the mother of Crona, who is also the crown jewel in her master plan: the destruction of the current world order to get the planet back on track.
12982: Mifune, known by the epithet "God of the Sword", is an infamous samurai and bodyguard who acts as a guardian to the little witch, Angela Leon. He is later blackmailed into the service of Arachnophobia by its head, Arachne Gorgon.
13046: The legendary sword used by heroes and kings. It has a great power that is unmatched by any other weapon. It turns out that anyone can use Excalibur. However, no one can put up with its personality (it has a bigger ego than Black Star).
13689: Eruka Frog is a frog-themed witch who serves under Medusa Gorgon. Like many other witches, Eruka craves destruction and enjoys the fact that she was born a Witch.
13712: Although she is a witch, her magical power is weak due to her youth; consequently, she relies on Mifune to protect her as a bodyguard. She is a chameleon witch capable of using invisibility magic, though the spell is still imperfect, leaving parts of her body visible.
14019: The Death Scythe in charge of Europe. Dressed in a priestly garb and earphones, Justin is devout in his services to the Shinigami. Justin is the youngest in the DWMA's history to become a Death Scythe at the age of thirteen, all without the aid of a partner.
14062: A top-class elite meister at Death Weapon Meister Academy, partner of Harvar D. Éclair, and a part of Kilik's team. Considered one of the top students in terms of grades within the DWMA, second only to Maka Albarn.
14063: The partner and meister of Jacqueline and one of the top students in the EAT Class. She is the object of Ox's affections but she constantly turns him down.
14064: A popular EAT-Class Meister partnered with twin weapons, Fire and Thunder. He is considered one of the top three student fighters in the DWMA, and is good friends with Ox and Kim.
14066: Harvar D. Éclair is the demon weapon partner of Ox Ford and one of the top student at Death Weapon Meister Academy.
14067: An honor student in the E.A.T Class and demon weapon partner of Kim Diehl.
14068: Pot of Thunder, or simply Thunder, is one of Kilik's two weapon partners and takes the form of a pot, although in weapon form it's shape is actually that of a glove.
14099: A Werewolf and the last of the Immortal Clan, imprisoned by the Witch Order for stealing Witch Queen Maba's left eye. After being freed by Eruka Frog on Medusa Gorgon's orders, he renames himself in honor of his freedom and joins her group, acting as one of her operatives.
14960: Called "Little Demon" by Soul Eater, he is a strange demonic imp that appeared before Soul inside his heart after his first encounter with Ragnarök. He told Soul "to be strong... follow me..." when soul decides to follow the imp states; "There will be insanity and ecstasy of joy.
15769: The Death Scythe formerly in charge of Oceania. However, after the resurrection of Asura, her duties were reassigned to Azusa. She is currently partnered with Stein and is an instructor at the DWMA.
15770: The Death Scythe in charge of East Asia. She comes off as being bookish and analytical, she is very respectful to all, she was the one that talked Marie out of marrying a toilet using wordplay.
15840: The first-generation Kishin and one of the Great Old Ones whose affinity to madness resides in fear.
15977: Mizune is the surname of a large family of witches who all look alike and whose animal theme are mice. They speak by saying, "chi" (sound of a mouse squeak). One witch from this family is initially introduced as a friend of Eruka's.
16151: Giriko is an enchanter and demon weapon allied with the witch Arachne Gorgon, and serves as one of Arachnophobia's most powerful members.
16228: Arachne Gorgon was the head of Arachnophobia who conspired to replace Death Weapon Meister Academy's position as a world power using madness with her in charge.
16229: Replaces Medusa as the school's interim doctor. She is Sid's partner, and looks like a mummy due to the fact she is covered in bandages (although she is seen without the bandages). She becomes a combat knife in weapon form.
16582: A three-star meister partner to Mira Naigus, instructor of Death Weapon Meister Academy, and a high-ranking member of the DWMA Central Intelligence Agency.
16944: Referred to as "Mole Hunter" Joe Buttataki, Joe makes his first appearance at the end of chapter thirty-seven of the manga when he is called to Shibusen to investigate the possibility of a spy.
17032: During his one episode appearance, Hiro was a loser at Shibusen that couldn't do anything right, and was constantly picked on or used by other students. One day, Hiro learned of Excalibur, and seeked out to be his partner.
17813: The demon blade, Masamune, is an extremely dangerous weapon and Tsubaki's older brother. He wanders around, possessing others to use him as their weapon to collect any soul he wants. He speaks using ancient words and likes to write haiku.
17816: Mosquito is a bloodsucker who acted as Arachne's steward and Arachnophobia's top henchman. He carries himself in an aristocratic manner and is a genuine believer in Arachnophobia and his mistress.
17817: The Fisher King is an assassin for Arachnophobia. He is sent to capture a demon tool, but is easily defeated by Kid on the Runaway Express. His cannon arm is destroyed by a Mizune witch, and is killed by Sid.
20297: He is the father of Black Star and the leader of the infamous Star Clan. Much like Black Star, he was very bent towards being the best and winning every battle. In the past, White Star was put into a very similar situation as Black Star in his battle with Mifune.
27390: A bloodthirsty and malicious killer who seemingly enjoys attempting to end the lives of others.
27391: Works at Chupa Kyaburasu Cabaret house.
27392: Works at Chupa Kyaburasu Cabaret house.

27394: Lupin (ルパン, Rupan) was a phantom thief (怪盗, kaitō) in the human world. In the anime, he is shown to have stolen a large bag of pure souls.
27395: Samantha was a necromancer witch in an Egyptian pyramid, who resurrected a pharaoh but was latter consumed by the pharaoh. She was more of a generic witch, with no apparent animal theme. She also revived many mummies in the Pyramid of Anubis.
27396: Referred to as "Pharaoh" (ファラオ, Farao), he was an unnamed ancient pharaoh who resided in the Pyramid of Anubis. He was resurrected by the witch Samantha.
27397: Rasputin was only shown in the series for a few minutes, but from the statements that Rasputin made it was implied that his body was invulnerable against any form of bullet.
27398: Bloodthirsty killer of Emerald Lake Sonson J. (ソンソンJ, Sonson Jei) was an evil human soul.
27399: Ryoku is a young boy from Needle Village. Ryoku is one of the most level headed people in his village appearing as calm and collected through most occurrences, except when it comes to his fear/hatred of the Star Clan.
27400: Mabaa (魔婆, Mabaa) is the current leader of all witches. She is held in high regards for being almost as powerful as Shinigami-sama. Her left eye was taken by Free which is now covered by a bandage with 1/2 written across it. Her specialty is Spatial Magic.
27401: The Flying Dutchman (さまよえるオランダ人, Samayoeru Orandajin) was the soul of the ghost ship Nidhogg (ニーズヘッグ, Nīzuheggu) that was being used by Medusa to gather more souls for kishin.
30326: Commonly called Fire and Thunder are Kirikou Rung's weapon partners and take the form of "Pots", although in weapon form they are actually gloves. Fire and Thunder are young small twins, befitting their young age in comparison to other characters within the series.
